intro: Four moments that got me from a mechanical engineering degree to analysis work, in the order they happened.

slides.label: Dec 2023
slides.title: Design and Fabrication of a Pyrolysis Reactor for Efficient Energy Recovery from Cloth Contaminated with Used Engine Oil in Auto Repair and Maintenance Shops
slides.text: Auto repair shops throw away rags soaked in used engine oil, which is both a disposal problem and wasted fuel. With Kaye Antonnet R. Adolfo and Rhel Dhenissie C. Barina, under Dr. Edwin A. Carcasona, we designed and fabricated a pyrolysis reactor that heats those rags without oxygen so the oil comes back off as recoverable energy instead of going to landfill. We presented it at the 12th International Mechanical Engineering Research Conference in January 2024.

slides.title: Graduated Mechanical Engineering
slides.text: Finished BS Mechanical Engineering at the University of San Carlos, Cebu, in May 2024, after four years and a Dean's List citation along the way.

slides.label: Feb 2025

slides.label: May 2025
slides.title: Joined AvePoint, and became a Business Analyst
